title: XYZ Ltd v. Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax
text: The petitioner, XYZ Ltd, filed a writ petition challenging a reassessment notice issued by the Deputy Commissioner of Income Tax under Section 148 of the Income Tax Act beyond the period of four years. The assessment order for the relevant year had been passed after regular scrutiny under Section 143(3). The petitioner argued that reassessment beyond four years requires the Assessing Officer to show that there was failure to disclose fully and truly all material facts. The High Court examines the reassessment notice. The grounds stated by the Commissioner of Income Tax do not indicate any failure of disclosure. The reassessment notice is merely a change of opinion on the same facts. The court quashes the reassessment notice. The deduction under Section 80C allowed in the original assessment order stands. The Commissioner of Income Tax is restrained from reopening the assessment.
